title: Duff and Meat
statementMd:
Duff is addicted to meat! Malek wants to keep her happy for $*n*$ days. In order to be happy in $*i*$-th day, she needs to eat exactly $*a*_{*i*}$ kilograms of meat.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/408ecd6fff6eb6cc315fe2848c534ccd0969bd1f.png)

There is a big shop uptown and Malek wants to buy meat for her from there. In $*i*$-th day, they sell meat for $*p*_{*i*}$ dollars per kilogram. Malek knows all numbers $*a*_{1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ and $*p*_{1}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$. In each day, he can buy arbitrary amount of meat, also he can keep some meat he has for the future.

Malek is a little tired from cooking meat, so he asked for your help. Help him to minimize the total money he spends to keep Duff happy for $*n*$ days.

## Input

The first line of input contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of days.

In the next $*n*$ lines, $*i*$-th line contains two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *p*_{*i*} ≤ 100$), the amount of meat Duff needs and the cost of meat in that day.

## Output

Print the minimum money needed to keep Duff happy for $*n*$ days, in one line.

## Note

In the first sample case: An optimal way would be to buy 1 kg on the first day, 2 kg on the second day and 3 kg on the third day.

In the second sample case: An optimal way would be to buy 1 kg on the first day and 5 kg (needed meat for the second and third day) on the second day.
statementZhMd:
Duff 对肉上瘾了！Malek 想让她在 $*n*$ 天内一直开心。为了在第 $*i*$ 天感到开心，她需要恰好吃掉 $*a*_{*i*}$ 千克肉。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/408ecd6fff6eb6cc315fe2848c534ccd0969bd1f.png)

城里有一家大型商店，Malek 想从那里为她购买肉。在第 $*i*$ 天，肉的售价为每千克 $*p*_{*i*}$ 美元。Malek 知道所有的 $*a*_{*1}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 和 $*p*_{*1}, ..., *p*_{*n*}$。每天，他都可以购买任意数量的肉，也可以将手头的一部分肉留到以后使用。

Malek 有点厌倦了烹饪肉类，因此向你寻求帮助。请帮助他计算出让 Duff 在 $*n*$ 天内一直开心所需花费的最少总金额。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示天数。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *p*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），分别表示 Duff 所需的肉量以及当天肉的价格。

## 输出格式

输出让 Duff 在 $*n*$ 天内一直开心所需的最少金额，单独一行。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，一种最优方案是在第一天购买 1 千克，第二天购买 2 千克，第三天购买 3 千克。

在第二个样例中，一种最优方案是在第一天购买 1 千克，并在第二天购买 5 千克（第二天和第三天所需的肉）。
